description: A server starts with nothing needing it (LazyConnect)
A call the host refused goes out anyway (SEC-01)
A refused call's permission is recorded as given
Waiting calls stay behind when their server is ready
old:
/\ call' = [c \in Calls |-> IF c \in Waiting(s) THEN "sent" ELSE call[c]]
    /\ retry' = [retry EXCEPT ![s] = FALSE]
    /\ asked' = [asked EXCEPT ![s] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<attempts, ended, allowed, cause, host, stayed, dropped>>
new:
/\ retry' = [retry EXCEPT ![s] = FALSE]
    /\ asked' = [asked EXCEPT ![s] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<attempts, call, ended, allowed, cause, host, stayed, dropped>>

description: A server gives up a try early
A server never gives up, so a call waits on it forever
A host drop leaves calls in flight on a link that is gone
old: /\ call' = [c \in Calls |-> IF c \in Sent(s) \/ (~keep /\ c \in Waiting(s)) THEN "done" ELSE call[c]]
new: /\ call' = [c \in Calls |-> IF ~keep /\ c \in Waiting(s) THEN "done" ELSE call[c]]

description: A failed or ready server takes a tool list need
A failed start keeps the calls waiting on it, even when the server gives up
old: /\ call' = [c \in Calls |-> IF c \in Sent(s) \/ c \in Waiting(s) THEN "done" ELSE call[c]]
new: /\ call' = [c \in Calls |-> IF c \in Sent(s) THEN "done" ELSE call[c]]

description: A call to a failed server waits instead of ending
A call goes out to a server still connecting
A host drop resets every server
old:
/\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![s] = "idle"]
    /\ attempts' = [attempts EXCEPT ![s] = 0]
    /\ need' = [need EXCEPT ![s] = need[s] /\ keep]
new:
/\ phase' = [t \in Servers |-> "idle"]
    /\ attempts' = [attempts EXCEPT ![s] = 0]
    /\ need' = [need EXCEPT ![s] = need[s] /\ keep]

description: One server's failure loses another server's calls
old: /\ call' = [c \in Calls |-> IF c \in Sent(s) \/ c \in Waiting(s) THEN "done" ELSE call[c]]
new: /\ call' = [c \in Calls |-> IF call[c] = "sent" \/ c \in Waiting(s) THEN "done" ELSE call[c]]

description: A ready server keeps the tool list need
old:
/\ need' = [need EXCEPT ![s] = FALSE]
    /\ call' = [c \in Calls |-> IF c \in Waiting(s) THEN "sent" ELSE call[c]]
new:
/\ need' = need
    /\ call' = [c \in Calls |-> IF c \in Waiting(s) THEN "sent" ELSE call[c]]

description: A server down by a failure never starts again by itself
A server's tries start over the moment it is up, so one that dies after every start loops
old:
/\ retry' = [retry EXCEPT ![s] = FALSE]
    /\ asked' = [asked EXCEPT ![s] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<attempts, ended, allowed, cause, host, stayed, dropped>>
new:
/\ retry' = [retry EXCEPT ![s] = FALSE]
    /\ asked' = [asked EXCEPT ![s] = FALSE]
    /\ attempts' = [attempts EXCEPT ![s] = 0]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ended, allowed, cause, host, stayed, dropped>>

description: A host disconnect leaves a server starting again by itself
old:
/\ retry' = [retry EXCEPT ![s] = FALSE]
    /\ dropped' = [dropped EXCEPT ![s] = TRUE]

description: A disconnect clears the tool list need without answering it, so a host waiting for it waits for ever
A call waits through every try, not just one start
old:
/\ call' = [c \in Calls |-> IF c \in Sent(s) \/ c \in Waiting(s) THEN "done" ELSE call[c]]
       /\ ended' = [c \in Calls |-> IF c \in Sent(s) THEN "lost"
                                    ELSE IF c \in Waiting(s) THEN "failed" ELSE ended[c]]
new:
/\ call' = [c \in Calls |-> IF c \in Sent(s) \/ (gaveUp /\ c \in Waiting(s)) THEN "done" ELSE call[c]]
       /\ ended' = [c \in Calls |-> IF c \in Sent(s) THEN "lost"
                                    ELSE IF gaveUp /\ c \in Waiting(s) THEN "failed" ELSE ended[c]]
